candidates.title: 12 Monkeys
candidates.reason: Across four completed seasons, Cole and Railly's investigation evolves from identifying a plague's origin into unraveling the Witness, the Army of the 12 Monkeys and self-reinforcing temporal paradoxes. TVMaze's season-by-season descriptions document successive answers and changing goals; the final season's episode guide follows specific clues, a weapon hunt and the resolution of the central cycle. Independent full-series and finale criticism corroborates that mysteries receive repeated payoffs rather than remaining a pilot-only premise. The structure offers sustained investigative clues, reversals and time-rule discovery. Weaknesses: considerable apocalyptic action, survival stakes, relationship drama and a romance-driven final resolution; the concluding emotional coda and some time-travel logic have divided viewers. Scores are descriptive evidence-based estimates, not final match scores.
